meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** ek achha beginner-friendly option hai—stable vitamin C formula aur reasonable price ke saath. Agar skin sensitive hai, to **Foxtale 10% Vitamin C-Glutathione** ya **Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide & 10% Vitamin C Ampoule** jaise gentler options consider karein.[1][2][8][10]

### Skin type ke hisaab se picks

- **Beginner / normal skin:** Minimalist 10% Vitamin C  
- **Oily ya acne-prone skin:** The Derma Co 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide  
- **Sensitive skin:** Foxtale 10% Vitamin C-Glutathione ya Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide + Vitamin C  
- **Stubborn pigmentation, experienced users:** Plum 15% Vitamin C ya Biluma 15% Vitamin C—pehle patch test zaroor karein.[1][2][5][8]

### Kaise use karein

Subah clean, dry face par **2–3 drops**, phir moisturiser aur **broad-spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen** lagayein. Vitamin C ke bina sunscreen dark spots ko effectively control nahi karega; serum pehle hafte mein alternate days use karke tolerance check karein.[8][10]

Ek waqt mein vitamin C ko strong exfoliating acids, retinol ya benzoyl peroxide ke saath layer na karein. Agar serum ka colour dark orange/brown ho gaya ho ya jalan, rash aur redness ho, use band kar dein. Dark spots 8–12 weeks mein gradually improve ho sakte hain; melasma ya persistent pigmentation ke liye dermatologist behtar rahega.
